record.summary: France's national institute for AI evaluation and security, created on 31 January 2025 ahead of the Paris AI Action Summit and steered by SGDSN and the Directorate General for Enterprise (DGE). It brings together ANSSI, Inria, LNE and PEReN to build a public capacity to evaluate advanced AI. Its 2026-2027 roadmap sets eleven projects: evaluation tools for AI Act market surveillance authorities, standards work and synthetic-content detection; research on systemic risks from information manipulation, offensive cyber capabilities and CBRN proliferation, and on agentic systems; and performance challenges. SGDSN represents France in the international network of AI safety institutes.
record.notes: SGDSN announced on 12 Feb 2026 that INESIA had adopted its 2026-2027 roadmap, with eleven projects in three poles (support for AI regulation, systemic risks, performance and reliability) and a cross-cutting axis. SGDSN says the network of AI Safety Institutes was renamed the 'International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science' in December 2025. The DGE leads exchanges with the European Commission, in particular its AI Office.

judgment.status_reasoning: INESIA is a standing institute without a founding legal act among the stored files. The SGDSN mission page, dated 5 Feb 2026 and stored on 17 Oct 2026, describes it as active under SGDSN and DGE steering, and SGDSN announced its 2026-2027 roadmap on 12 Feb 2026. Nothing stored says it was wound up or replaced. 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A national AI evaluation and security institute and France's member of the international AI safety institutes network; clearly in scope (mandates of AI safety bodies), no scope_note.
judgment.date_last_updated_reasoning: 12 Feb 2026 is the date of SGDSN's news item announcing the roadmap's adoption; the mission page, dated 5 Feb 2026, already refers to the roadmap, so the adoption itself may be a few days earlier; press release no. 373, dated 12 Feb 2026, announces the adoption without giving another date, so 12 Feb 2026 is kept.
